lines.say: After a crash, the storm hits fast. McMinn Law Firm has you covered.
Medical bills. Calls from the insurance company. Lost paychecks.
We stand between you and the insurance company.
We investigate, we negotiate, and when we need to, we go to trial.
So you can focus on getting better.
